responsibility: Main implementation file for the ARC target backend. It owns the target hooks and RTL-side behavior for ARC code generation, including option-driven feature handling, address legitimacy, instruction printing and length adjustment, prologue/epilogue expansion, conditional-execution and delay-slot state machines, constant/materialization splitting, atomic and compare-and-swap expansion helpers, hazard and cost modeling, call/return decisions, and final targetm hook registration.
same_name_distinction: This is the ARC backend’s compiled implementation source: unlike arc.h it defines behavior, unlike arc.md it is not the RTL pattern file, and unlike arc.opt it does not declare command-line options; it supplies the hook bodies and helper routines that the header, machine description, and options feed into.
